en.hubeali:
A number of our companions, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Khalid, from Bakr Bin Salih, from Suleyman Al Ja’fary, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Al-Hassan Al-Reza<sup>asws</sup> having said: ‘
The peacock, it is not Permissible to eat it nor its eggs’.
en.sarwar: 9. A number of our people have narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid from Bakr ibn Salih from Sulayman ibn Ja‘far who has said the following: “I once asked abu al-Hassan, al-Rida’, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about peacock.
He (the Imam) said, ‘It is not lawful to use it or its eggs for food.’”
